title: Cosine Schedule with Warmup
signature: def cosine_lr(steps, base_lr, warmup_steps, total_steps, min_lr=0.0) -> np.ndarray
hints: Handle the two phases separately, then combine them with np.where.
Warmup is base_lr * s / warmup_steps, so step 0 has lr 0.
The cosine factor 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * p)) goes from 1 to 0. Scale it into [min_lr, base_lr] and clip p at 1 so steps past the end stay at min_lr.
